howto_1: ROLL your dices and pick minimum 3 of them: matching elements form a combo (Trio, Duo Pact, Full Moon, Quartet) will summon units. You can cherry pick dices to REROLL.
howto_2: SUMMON your units based on combos and elements. The score on each dice nets you points, from left to right. Then trinkets will be applied. 3 summons per battle.
howto_3: The army attacks the hunter. Beat its number of HP and the battle ends at once; unused summons pay $1 each.
howto_4: In the Crypt Market buy trinkets, potions (rewrite faces, add runes), gems (level combos), new dice and gear. Survive 8 nights.
tut_first_roll: ROLL your dice, pick dices and form a combo if possible (3 of an element, 2+2, a ritual...), then SUMMON.
tut_first_shop: Trinkets trigger left to right. Drag to reorder.
tut_first_summon: Army strength = Power × Count. When the army beats the hunter (or not) the battle ends (or you lose).
